product_summary: A lightweight web-based financial management tool that allows users to securely log daily expenditures, categorize transactions, and visualize spending habits through automated reports.
problem_statement: Individuals often struggle to maintain a clear overview of their personal finances due to fragmented tracking methods. There is a need for a centralized, accessible, and simple interface to record expenses and analyze spending patterns over time.
success_metrics: Daily Active Users (DAU) logging at least one expense
Average number of expenses logged per user per week

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Secure sign-up and login system using email and password.
acceptance_criteria: User can create an account with a unique email.
User can log in and receive a secure session token (JWT).
Passwords must be hashed before storage.

features.name: Expense Management
features.description: Core CRUD functionality for tracking individual expenses.
acceptance_criteria: User can add an expense with amount, date, category, and description.
User can view a list of their own expenses.
User can edit or delete an existing expense entry.
Expenses are private to the logged-in user.

features.name: Expense Categorization
features.description: System for organizing expenses into logical groups.
acceptance_criteria: Pre-defined categories (Food, Transport, Rent, Utilities, Entertainment).
Ability to filter the expense list by category.

features.name: Spending Reports
features.description: Visual and tabular summaries of spending data.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard showing total spending for the current month.
Breakdown of spending by category (e.g., Pie chart).

features.name: Data Export
features.description: Allow users to download their data for external use.
acceptance_criteria: User can export expense history to a CSV file.

user_flows.name: Onboarding and First Entry
steps: Click Sign Up and enter credentials
Save and see the updated dashboard

modules.name: Identity Module
modules.responsibility: Handles user registration, authentication, and session management.

modules.name: Expense Core Module
modules.responsibility: Manages the lifecycle of expense records and category definitions.

modules.name: Analytics Module
modules.responsibility: Aggregates raw expense data into meaningful statistics and chart-ready formats.

modules.name: Web Frontend
modules.responsibility: Provides the user interface for interaction and data visualization.

expected_scale: 10k DAU at launch, 100k total users in year 1

data_entities.name: User
data_entities.description: Represents a registered person in the system.

data_entities.name: Expense
data_entities.description: A single financial transaction recorded by a user.

possible_apis.description: Retrieve a list of expenses for the authenticated user with optional filters.
Get aggregated spending data for the dashboard.

functional_requirements: The system must allow users to reset their passwords via email (Post-MVP).
The system must support decimal values for expense amounts (up to 2 decimal places).
The system must prevent users from accessing or modifying expenses belonging to other users.
The system must provide a default set of categories for all users.

non_functional_requirements.description: API response time for fetching expenses should be under 300ms.
All data in transit must be encrypted via TLS 1.2+.
The application should maintain high availability.

constraints: The application must be responsive and work on both desktop and mobile browsers.
The initial version will support only one currency (USD).
assumptions: Users have a stable internet connection to access the web interface.
A relational database is preferred to ensure ACID compliance for financial data.
open_questions: Should users be allowed to create custom categories in the MVP?
Is multi-currency support required for the first release?
Do we need to support social logins (Google/GitHub) in the first phase?
out_of_scope: Shared accounts or group expense tracking.
